vulnerability: SNI/domain-fronting bypass via CONNECT tunnel to CDN-shared allowed domain (registry.npmjs.org, nodejs.org, esm.sh, cdn.jsdelivr.net, bun.sh, json-schema.org, deno.land, www.googleapis.com -> shared CDN edge -> arbitrary fronted domain incl. example.com). Recurring and unresolved since run 34807416060. This run reproduced the core bypass, added 2 new non-Cloudflare-limited pivot hosts (deno.land, www.googleapis.com on Google infra), and confirmed via WebSocket-Upgrade probe that Squid performs zero post-TLS-handshake payload inspection, meaning arbitrary bidirectional traffic (not just simple GET) can be smuggled once the SNI swap succeeds.
